name: Sling Button
description: Round send button you drag back like a slingshot. A rubber band stretches, an arc fills as it arms, and on release the pad springs forward and bursts particles while firing onSend.
contents: Circular draggable pad button with an arrow icon or custom children
Dark circular well behind the pad with a progress arc
Stretching rubber band drawn between well and pad
Burst of particle dots on launch
behavior: Dragging pulls the pad with rubber-band resistance up to maxPull, the icon rotates to aim opposite the pull
Arc and band highlight fill as the pull approaches armAt, the pad scales up and strokes thicken once armed
Releasing when armed calls onSend, springs the pad back with recoil and sprays particles opposite the pull
Releasing before arming or pressing Escape cancels and springs back without sending
A tap or click without dragging calls onSend when tapSends is true
Reduced motion skips the spring and particles and only flashes the well and fades the band
Hover and press scale the pad slightly on fine pointers
editableByProps: All colors: pad, icon, accent, well and band
Pull distance to arm, max pull, launch speed and spring recoil
Particle count, flight distance and spread angle
Drag axis lock (any, horizontal or vertical), tap to send, disabled state
Custom icon or content through children, aria label, extra class name, onSend callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the screen reader hint text
needsCodeEdit.where: The span with id hintId at the end of the returned JSX

needsCodeEdit.change: Change particle animation duration or easing

needsCodeEdit.where: HugeiconsIcon with ArrowUp02Icon in the button children fallback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change velocity caps for the throw

fixed: Requires Tailwind CSS with arbitrary value and group-data variants, plus motion and @hugeicons/react with @hugeicons/core-free-icons
Only the primary mouse button starts a drag, pointer capture is used and touch scrolling is disabled on the button (touch-none)
Gap between pad and well is fixed at 4px
Particle dots use the accent color and always fly opposite the pull direction
Drag-based interaction, touch users must drag, though a tap still sends when tapSends is true
Keyboard activation (Enter or Space) sends directly through the click handler, drag is pointer only
